description: Figure 4 presents a line plot comparing the Macro-F1 scores for two tokenization models—MATTER and a version without material knowledge (w/o material knowledge)—as the number of tokens used during training varies. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” is plotted on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0.5x to 1.5x of the original token count, with tick marks at regular intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The plot contains two lines: a solid black line representing the MATTER model, which starts at a Macro-F1 score of approximately 0.75 at 0.5x and rises to about 0.85 at 1.5x; and a dashed black line representing the w/o material knowledge model, which begins at a score of approximately 0.70 at 0.5x and increases to about 0.78 at 1.5x. Both lines show an upward trend, indicating improved performance as the number of tokens increases, with the MATTER model consistently outperforming the baseline.
